result: Tests/build pass and several hardening items are fixed: journal manifests persist prior mods/profiles/mod-list and replay on next mutation; archive metadata name/version is validated before path construction; profile apply enforces installed required versions; UI role/stopped guards, confirmations, bulk payload, profiles, and CSRF/audit routes remain correct. Remaining transaction gaps: journal recovery does not restore archive files/overwritten bulk destinations; bulk promotion overwrites and rollback can lose preexisting archives; commit does not restore SQLite if mod-list write fails; malformed journal JSON can block next mutation; install/update/bulk dependency graph validation is inconsistent. Focused tests remain limited and do not exercise these failure paths or live endpoint roles/CSRF/audit.

evidence.outcome: journal manifest/state replay, archive metadata/path validation, profile version checks present but archive snapshots/overwrite rollback/cross-store rollback gaps remain
role/status guards, confirmations, bulk/profile payloads and UI wiring correct
mod routes remain inside authenticated CSRF/audit/mutation authorization group

next_slice.summary: Implement archive-aware journal recovery or durable staged promotion preserving overwritten files, restore SQLite/mod-list consistently on failure, quarantine malformed journals, validate dependency graphs after install/update/bulk, and add focused failure-injection/endpoint authorization tests.

blockers: Cross-store rollback can leave SQLite/mod-list inconsistent.
Install/update/bulk dependency validation and failure-injection endpoint coverage incomplete.
